rules.quartiles: nearest-rank over the image counts of ALL groups: cut_k = sizes[ceil(k*n/4) - 1], k = 1..3; bucket = number of cuts strictly below the size
rules.d_select_strata: D_select reuses the strata of D (same cut points), restricted to D
rules.rounding: exact half-up: floor(f*n + 1/2) in decimal arithmetic
rules.folds: one round-robin counter 0..4 that continues across strata (strata in sorted order)
rules.hash_order: canonical_hash([algorithm, seed_of_stage, stage, group]) with stages DE, D-select, E-folds

seed_rationale: same fractions/thresholds as ISIC 2020; seeds fixed on the decision date, evaluation seed distinct (Q3); chosen before any split, score or model output
no_reseed: No other seed is tried after any split audit, score or result is seen; a failed audit stops and is escalated.
supersedes: nothing in the acquisition config: configs/acquisition/rsna2018-v1.json declares no splits block and acquisition verify creates no pools/folds; this amendment is the sole split pre-registration of rsna2018
